blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—Talisay City unleashed a balanced offensive attack to dismantle Ronda, 143-50, and complete a sweep of Group D in the South Division of the Cebu Governor’s Cup Under-18 basketball tournament over the weekend at the Talisay City Sports Complex. The host team secured a convincing victory with a 93-point winning margin, which could stand as the biggest rout of the tournament. Ronda opened the game with a 4-0 run in the first quarter, but Talisay quickly took control and never looked back.
